changes: First release in Modwerk for the original Digitakt on OS 1.53 and 1.54: DT-FM, a four-operator FM synth machine with eight algorithms.
Each operator has its own ratio, level and envelope; operator 4 has feedback. Every SRC control takes parameter locks.
Turn on digihealth's FAST AUDIO before playing several DT-FM tracks: without it the Digitakt can freeze.
Not with SOPHIE, and, through Machine Pages, not with Digi Mono, Digi Poly, NEIGHBOR or DIGISLICER.
